name: Hyke: Northern Light(s) - A Witch’s Chill Time
summary: “A Witch’s Chill Time” takes places after the resolution of the main campaign with the days of fierce battle finally behind them. A period of tranquility settled in—until one day, guided by an invitation from Aurora, Hyke and the group stepped into a mysterious realm. What greeted their eyes there was—none other than a “hot spring.” However, it turned out that during the process of creating this space, Aurora had misplaced the very items needed to fully enjoy the hot spring experience. To recover these lost items, Haiku and the others set out to explore the depths of the mysterious realm. And so, a new adventure begins—one dedicated to bringing Hyke and the group’s “ideal hot spring” to perfection!
